title: Define source-bound historical audit findings registry
objective: Define a canonical read-only findings registry contract bound to validated ENG-07.2 manifest and ENG-07.3 traceability identities, with explicit severity, ownership and disposition, without executing audits or populating real historical findings.
non_goals: populate findings for real historical lots
change historical mapping schema policy or coverage semantics
modify data/audit reports contracts or business code
integrate new checks into CI in this WU

required_invariants: findings registry is READ_ONLY and stored outside immutable historical certification evidence
registry is bound to one validated historical manifest identity and one validated traceability mapping identity
registry plan batch and lot identities must match the bound manifest and mapping
finding ids are stable deterministic batch-lot-local identifiers
every finding has explicit severity owner status disposition and requirement binding
severity order is BLOCKER MAJOR MINOR INFO and cannot be silently downgraded
open or unresolved findings remain machine-visible
accepted-risk false-positive deferred and remediation-required dispositions require explicit rationale
zero findings is a valid clean audit result and must not be confused with missing registry data
registry identity is SHA-256 over canonical material excluding only its identity field
mutation permissions remain false and validator performs no repository mutation
acceptance_criteria: clean synthetic registry with zero findings validates deterministically through validator self-check
synthetic populated registry validates with sorted unique finding ids through validator self-check
registry bound to forged manifest mapping plan batch or lot identity fails closed
invalid severity status disposition or missing owner fails closed
duplicate or unsorted finding ids fail closed
finding requirement id not present in bound mapping fails closed
non-open disposition without required rationale fails closed
Lot45 or later registry fails closed
absolute traversal or malformed repository references fail closed
no historical artifact business state or runtime authority is mutated
separate adversarial test module and CI qualification are deferred to ENG-07.4-WU02

done_when: findings schema policy and validator with deterministic self-check are defined
findings remain separate from immutable historical evidence and preserve explicit severity ownership and disposition
all registry identities remain bound to validated historical manifest and mapping identities
adversarial test module and CI integration are deferred to ENG-07.4-WU02
